candidates.name: Pneumonia
support_spans: cough and sputum with intermittent fever for 3 days
Few wet rales audible on lung auscultation
Multiple patchy high-density shadows in both lungs
candidates.why: The patient presents with respiratory symptoms and imaging findings consistent with pneumonia.

candidates.name: Influenza
support_spans: highest temperature reached 41°C with chills, cough, yellow sputum
candidates.why: The patient's high fever and respiratory symptoms are consistent with influenza.

candidates.name: Tuberculosis
support_spans: Past medical history included tuberculosis 10 years ago
candidates.why: The patient's history of tuberculosis could suggest a reactivation or relapse.

candidates.name: Pneumocystis pneumonia
support_spans: Patient works as a waste disposal worker and had recent poor sleep (2-3 hours per day)
candidates.why: The patient's occupation and sleep deprivation could increase the risk of opportunistic infections like Pneumocystis pneumonia.

candidates.name: Invasive aspergillosis
support_spans: Bronchoscopy: Small amount of mucous secretion in bronchial tubes
Alveolar lavage fluid mNGS: Detected TW with sequence number 36543 and abundance 0.43%
candidates.why: The patient's bronchoscopy and alveolar lavage fluid findings could suggest an invasive fungal infection like aspergillosis.

candidates.name: Cryptococcal pneumonia
support_spans: Chest CT: Multiple nodular and patchy high-density shadows in both lungs, with some foci of solid lesions
candidates.why: The patient's imaging findings could be consistent with a fungal infection like cryptococcal pneumonia.
